before: A run font written as a list or with an unusable name requested and painted its whole authored string, so the text could disappear from PDF export.
after: A listed name paints in its first family, and an unusable name paints in Cambria. Font table entries are read under the same first family.
reason: The change only reads the document: run font resolution for layout, paint, and font requests. Authored w:rFonts values, shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
